relationships.subject: dietary polyphenols
relationships.evidence_quote: Dietary polyphenols may influence this network through electrophilic or kinase-dependent NRF2 activation

key_findings: NRF2 links ferroptosis and pyroptosis in diabetic retinopathy, kidney disease and peripheral neuropathy; polyphenols are plausible multi-pathway modulators
Evidence is strongest preclinically (corilagin, resveratrol, quercetin, EGCG); human studies rarely measure ferroptosis/pyroptosis biomarkers
